# Wrong or default profile fails closed
A readiness probe for `wkr-wf01-a` is sent with `X-Hermes-Profile: default`, or with `X-Hermes-Profile: wkr-wf01-b-p1`. The controller compares the request profile, registry binding, and echoed response metadata before creating a run record.
```text result = 422 profile_not_distinct registry(wkr-wf01-a).dispatchable = false new WorkerRun records = 0 profile mutations = 0 recovery = rerun G7 with X-Hermes-Profile: wkr-wf01-a-p1 ```
Evidence query: `GET /chd/readiness/wkr-wf01-a/<probe>` and `GET /chd/audit/<timestamp>-<request_id>`. No default-profile fallback is permitted.
